description: 3-stage Jinja2 SSTI via NFKC normalization applied AFTER brace-character regex guard: (1) add email-template render endpoint with brace-guarded Jinja2, (2) add custom brace regex and error handling, (3) normalize user typography (smart quotes, fullwidth chars) with unicodedata.normalize(NFKC) before rendering. Fullwidth braces U+FF5B/U+FF5D bypass the ASCII brace regex and then NFKC-normalize into standard {{ }} — Jinja2 evaluates attacker's expression after the guard.
